query: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='2s'; SELECT jsonb_build_object('foreign_keys',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',conrelid::regclass::text,'name',conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid))) FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype='f' AND conrelid IN('public.orders'::regclass,'public.riders'::regclass,'public.order_parcel_photos'::regclass,'public.order_verifications'::regclass,'public.travel_matches'::regclass)),'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'name',indexname,'definition',indexdef)) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN('orders','riders','rider_kyc','order_parcel_photos','order_verifications','travel_matches','pricing_config','pricing_zones')),'triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tgrelid::regclass::text,'name',tgname,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(oid))) FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND tgrelid IN('public.orders'::regclass,'public.order_parcel_photos'::regclass,'public.order_verifications'::regclass,'public.travel_matches'::regclass)),'observed_at',clock_timestamp()) AS edge_relations; COMMIT;

triggers.name: trg_populate_order_code

triggers.name: trigger_assign_nearby_orders_on_rider_freed
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_assign_nearby_orders_on_rider_freed AFTER UPDATE OF order_status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.order_status = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::order_status_enum, 'rider_arrived'::order_status_enum, 'picked_up'::order_status_enum, 'ongoing'::order_status_enum, 'payment_pending'::order_status_enum])) AND (new.order_status <> ALL (ARRAY['accepted'::order_status_enum, 'rider_arrived'::order_status_enum, 'picked_up'::order_status_enum, 'ongoing'::order_status_enum, 'payment_pending'::order_status_enum])) AND (new.rider_id IS NOT NULL))) EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_nearby_searching_orders_on_rider_freed()

triggers.name: trigger_assign_new_order_to_nearby_riders

triggers.name: trigger_enforce_order_rider_service_mode
